sources.quote: SUP-B,Alluminio Bormida S.r.l.,aluminium blanks and bars
BR-310 brackets from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) may be packed 40 per layer

findings.why: The proposed change moves BR-310 extrusions to Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B). No controlled record covers SUP-B for BR-310. The documents give no part card, source approval, receiving plant or customer for BR-310. The only approved-source record is for BR-220, a different part. Bormida's approval for BR-310 therefore cannot be read as absent or present, and a person must confirm it. The key's customer part is unknown because no BR-310 program or customer is documented.
